If you have feedback contact me, (lukemathesonofficial) on discord!  Or send a message in the #Redlight channel in [url=https://discord.com/invite/gfjRsCU]OUR DISCORD[/url]

notes.title: Playtest for REDLIGHT is live NOW!
notes.notes:

If you have feedback contact me, (lukemathesonofficial) on discord!  Or send a message in the #Redlight channel in [url=https://discord.com/invite/gfjRsCU]OUR DISCORD[/url]

notes.title: Playtest Live Starting 4/9!
notes.notes: The open playtest for REDLIGHT will begin [b]April 9th at 12pm PST[/b]!  Those of you who have opted-in will have access to it until April 12th at 3pm PST.  I'm very excited to hear what you guys think and I'll be putting out patches for the playtest as feedback comes in!
